item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: Attention STA students! Get ready to dodge, duck, dive and make a difference! Our annual Movember Dodgeball Tournament is back on Wednesday, November 25, during Periods 3 and 4! Gather your friends, create a team of up to 10 players and compete for bragging rights, all while supporting men's health initiatives through Movember Canada! Registration is $50 per team, and spots are limited, so don't wait! Sign-up sheets are posted outside Mrs. Longval's office. Please be sure to check out the tournament posters for more details. Let's come together as a community, have some fun and support a great cause! Don't dodge the fun, have a BALL! Please stop by to chat with Mrs. Longval if you have any questions!
